revision_binding.reason: Tracked content cannot embed its own containing commit without circular identity.

content.purpose: Define one shared deterministic publication mechanism while keeping semantic validation, rendering, canonical fact interpretation, and family-specific manifest meaning in the owning documentation family.

adapter_protocol.validate: adapter(root, family) returns an object with status and diagnostics
adapter_protocol.build: adapter(root, family, replace=boolean) returns the family build manifest
adapter_protocol.verify: adapter(root, family) returns an object with status and diagnostics

kernel_owns: deterministic generated-file declarations and bundle hashes
exact generated file inventory and content drift checks
publication-family registry loading, validation, discovery, and orchestration

requirements.statement: Cross-family publication mechanics MUST be implemented by the shared publication kernel and MUST NOT be independently redefined by a publication family without an explicit family-specific requirement.
Every publication family MUST retain a named semantic owner and adapter; the publication kernel MUST NOT interpret or rewrite canonical domain facts.
Publication-family discovery MUST use urn:uuid:175c6e08-4ec3-5112-b34d-546b821fc252 as its canonical registry and MUST NOT maintain a second hard-coded family inventory.
Existing family-specific validation, build, and generated-output verification commands MUST remain compatible while a family remains active.
Generated publication output MUST remain a deterministic downstream projection with no write-back authority.
External references, inferred evidence, and moving live web content MUST NOT become canonical KIS facts or silent deterministic build inputs through the publication kernel.
A publication bundle MUST be staged completely before replacement of the current bundle, and replacement failure MUST restore the previous complete bundle when recovery is possible.
Exact publication verification MUST detect missing, extra, changed, stale, or tampered generated files and manifest drift.
Every registered publication adapter MUST conform to the versioned adapter protocol for invocation shape and validation or verification result envelopes.

Every registered publication family MUST explicitly declare whether it is eligible for the reader-facing documentation site; site routes, public search, and the GitHub Pages release MUST derive family membership only from that governed registry decision and MUST NOT infer public visibility by registration alone.
